# Nails Euphoria Avery Ranch

> Nail & lash studio based in Austin, Texas. Nails Euphoria on West Parmer is a quaint Avery Ranch studio for healthy, strong nails, marble and ombré art, and classic or volume lash sets from Ann, whom one client drives two hours to see.

- Phone: (512) 244-2880
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Leander
- Yelp rating: 4.3 from 115 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nails-euphoria-avery-ranch/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/nails-euphoria-avery-ranch/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Lash extensions: Classic and volume lash sets from Ann, done gently.

## About
Nails Euphoria Avery Ranch is on West Parmer Lane. Techs including Mylissa, Hoan, Kim and Fannie do gel, ombré, marble and restructuring for torn nails, and Ann does classic and volume lash extensions. Clients say the team cares about nail health, not just looks, and the space is clean with lots of colors. Lash clients call Ann patient and gentle, even for nervous first-timers.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Nails Euphoria Avery Ranch?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 244-2880 or book online.
- Q: Where is Nails Euphoria Avery Ranch?
  A: 10510 W Parmer Ln, Ste 108, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Nails Euphoria?
  A: Nails Euphoria Avery Ranch is rated 4.3 stars from 115 Yelp reviews. Clients mention nail-health care, beautiful ombré and marble, and patient lash work.
